pages.title: Reformers
pages.text: The $(l)Reformers$() are the Federation bloc that wants the Charter to move faster, write less, and recognise alchemy and source-work as Charter-grade engineering.$(br2)They are led, informally, by $(l)Saskia Veridian$() of Veridian Pier.

Reformer colonies tend to be the ones with $(o)mixed forges$() — brass and source, steam and alchemy, builders and Source Relays standing in the same yard.$(br2)The Charter has not, officially, decided what to do with them. The Charter rarely officially decides anything.
Reformers are not radicals. They write very polite letters. The trouble is that they write very $(o)many$() of them, and they expect responses, and the Charter clerks are slow.
